function.name: get_setup_dimensions
function.description: How the catalog splits: the company default account per type, the existing rule count, and for each dimension (category, brand, supplier, type) its groups { id, name, product_count }, how many products it covers and how many have no value. (GET /api/product-account-rules/setup/dimensions)

function.name: list_account_rules
function.description: The existing rules in order (first match wins), each with its conditions, accounts, match_count and is_active. Paginated. (GET /api/product-account-rules)

function.name: list_products
function.description: Products with sku, type, brand_id/brand_name, default_supplier_id/default_supplier_name, primary_category_id/primary_category_path, tags, each *_nominal_code_id override and the resolved *_account with *_account_source (product_override, rule, company_default). (GET /api/v2/products)

per_page.description: Page size. Iterate page to last_page.

filter[search].description: Matches SKU, name and other searchable fields.

function.name: list_nominal_codes
function.description: The chart of accounts: { id, code, name, type, archived_at } per account. Rules and overrides take these ids, not account numbers. Archived accounts are excluded by default. (GET /api/v2/nominal-codes)

function.name: preview_setup
function.description: Read-only. Given a dimension and accounts per group, returns the rules it would create, the products whose own override disagrees (exceptions), totals (will_change, on_company_default, keep_override) and the before/after account map. Saves nothing. (POST /api/product-account-rules/setup/preview)

groups.description: One entry per group to give accounts: { id, accounts: { sales, cogs, inventory, inventory_in_transit, accrued_purchases, discount } } with nominal code ids. Group ids come from get-setup-dimensions (a product type's id is the type name). Omit an account to leave it on the company default.

use_rule_product_ids.description: Product ids whose overrides should be cleared so they follow the new rules.

channel_accounts_take_priority.description: When true, a sales channel's own sales, COGS and discount accounts win over the new rules.

function.name: apply_setup
function.description: Writes the previewed rules above any existing ones (never edits or deletes a rule) and clears the overrides named in use_rule_product_ids. Same body as preview-setup. Products move in a background job. Needs the accounting.manage_settings permission. (POST /api/product-account-rules/setup/apply)

function.name: preview_rule
function.description: Read-only. What one draft rule would do: matches, will_change, a by-account breakdown and a sample of products that move. Use for a rule the setup dimensions can't express (a tag, a SKU prefix, or two conditions together). (POST /api/product-account-rules/preview)

conditions.description: Any of category_ids, include_subcategories, category_scope (primary|any), brand_ids, supplier_ids, product_types, tag_ids, sku_prefixes (max 5). All set conditions must match.

accounts.description: Account type → nominal code id (sales, cogs, inventory, inventory_in_transit, accrued_purchases, discount).

function.name: create_rule
function.description: Creates one rule (same body as preview-rule, plus optional position, is_active and channel_accounts_take_priority). A blank position puts it above the first broader rule. Needs the accounting.manage_settings permission. (POST /api/product-account-rules)

function.name: get_account_map
function.description: Where the catalog posts now: per group, how many products post to each account and whether from rules, overrides or the company default, plus anomalies (products unlike 80%+ of their category). (GET /api/product-account-map)

account_type.description: sales, cogs, inventory, inventory_in_transit, accrued_purchases or discount.

function.name: get_product_accounts
function.description: Resolved accounts for up to 200 products: per account type the account, its source, the override id, and whether a rule would apply (rule_would_apply, rule_account). (GET /api/products/accounts)

function.name: set_product_override
function.description: Sets a single product's own account override. Send only the *_nominal_code_id fields being set. Not available through the SKU.io MCP server's api_write; there, leave exceptions to a person. (PUT /api/products/{id})

sales_nominal_code_id.description: Nominal code id for this product's sales override.

cogs_nominal_code_id.description: Nominal code id for this product's COGS override.
